name: KDPBook
tagline: Make a print-ready KDP book from one sentence
description: KDPBook is an AI book creator for Amazon KDP. Describe a book in one sentence and an AI editor plans it with you, writes and illustrates every page, and checks trim, bleed, margins, spine and resolution, then exports an interior PDF, wrap cover PDF, Kindle EPUB and a listing kit. Free to start with 1,500 credits.
